verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://www.lowenstein.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with actual firm-summary content, and supplementary citations quote real text pulled from that file (deal volume, offices, lawyer count), showing it is a genuine, populated llms.txt an agent could consume. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation beyond the single probe, and no broader agent-oriented docs (e.g., structured API docs) beyond the one llms.txt file.
